test_cases.description: bootstrapApp with valid config mounts app and returns BootstrapResult with all 13 routes/components
test_cases.expected_output_description: BootstrapResult with routeCount=13, pageComponentCount=13, allRoutesHaveComponents=true, targetElementId='root'

test_cases.description: bootstrapApp with custom targetElementId mounts into that element
bootstrapApp throws target_element_not_found when DOM element missing
assertions: throws error indicating target element not found

test_cases.description: bootstrapApp throws manifest_component_mismatch when map keys don't match manifest
assertions: throws error indicating manifest component mismatch

test_cases.description: bootstrapApp throws render_failure when renderEntryPoint throws
bootstrapApp calls getRouteManifest and getPageComponentMap exactly once each
bootstrapApp verifies bijection before calling renderEntryPoint
assertions: renderEntryPoint not called if bijection fails

test_cases.description: verifyManifestComponentBijection returns isValid=true when manifest and map keys match exactly
verifyManifestComponentBijection detects keys missing from map
verifyManifestComponentBijection detects extra keys in map not in manifest
verifyManifestComponentBijection is pure — same inputs yield same outputs
assertions: two calls with identical inputs return deeply equal results

test_cases.description: getRouteManifest returns exactly 13 RouteEntry objects
assertions: every entry has path, label, componentKey

test_cases.description: getRouteManifest returns entries with all unique paths
getRouteManifest covers all 13 PageComponentKey variants
assertions: componentKeys set equals PageComponentKey enum set

test_cases.description: getPageComponentMap returns map with exactly 13 entries all being functions
getPageComponentMap has every PageComponentKey as a key
assertions: all 13 PageComponentKey values present as keys

test_cases.description: buildPageComponentMap returns map with 13 entries keyed by PageComponentKey
getProjectManifest returns manifest with correct projectName and devServerPort
getRequiredDependencies returns correct counts
BootstrapConfig with empty targetElementId is invalid
assertions: rejects or throws due to empty targetElementId

test_cases.description: The set of componentKeys in route manifest equals the set of keys in page component map
assertions: componentKeys from manifest === keys from pageComponentMap
